evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Distinct search method (fingerprinting) not substantially contained in other stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based discovery is a different requirement from fingerprinting, similar-users, or metadata/tag-based discovery.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Similarity-to-other-users discovery differs meaningfully from profile-only discovery and from recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Video-seeded content-similarity discovery is distinct from other music discovery approaches and from image-seeded video recommendation.

evaluations.evidence: discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata/image-tag-driven discovery is not the same requirement as fingerprinting, profile, or similar-user discovery.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Tag persistence across processing is a distinct capability not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: UI feature for viewing segment thumbnails is not expressed by any other story.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Substantially overlaps with the next story that asks for info about similar (perceptually similar) video items and segments; no meaningful difference in actor/context/goal is stated.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates the requirement to get info about similar video items/segments; 'perceptually' is not established as a distinct business rule here.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation (push) based on similar profiles is distinct from search/discovery stories and from location/news-based recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: News-and-location-driven recommendations are distinct from similar-profile recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification is a different target entity than products/logos/brands.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is distinct from persons, logos, and brands as separate recognition targets.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster-logo identification is a distinct recognition target from brands/products/persons.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification is distinct from broadcaster logos and products as stated.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Image-seeded video recommendation is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Map-based browsing/notification is distinct from news-in-area recommendations and from other search methods.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a distinct search modality not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin segmentation validation/editing is distinct from annotation/topic extraction and other admin filters.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Topic extraction per segment is not duplicated by other admin stories.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: A/V quality filtering/ranking is distinct from nudity/copyright/asset-info prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Edited-audio detection is distinct from noise removal and other prefilters.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is a distinct business rule from copyright and asset-information searches.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset-information search differs from high-level metadata/tag search.

evaluations.evidence: validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation is distinct from nudity and asset-info prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag search is distinct from low-level asset-information search.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Interest/appeal/complexity assessment is distinct from prompting scientists or identifying volunteer types.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Scientist-prompt detection is a distinct action/goal from assessing interestingness.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer-type identification is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo preclassification is a different dataset/context than other preclassification stories (e.g., Snapshot Serengeti, Plankton Portal).

evaluations.evidence: detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Empty/none-classifiable detection is distinct from species/attribute/number preclassification in the same domain.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Series detection for timestamp malfunction is distinct from animal detection/preclassification tasks.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification differs from attribute and number detection requirements.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification is distinct from species preclassification and number detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Counting/number detection is distinct from species and attribute preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation/localization is distinct from detecting empty images, size/orientation, or species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Empty/none-classifiable detection is distinct from plankton segmentation and species/size tasks.

evaluations.evidence: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is distinct from species preclassification and segmentation/localization.

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is distinct from size/orientation detection and empty-image detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Motion analysis for duration reduction is distinct from detecting egg-laying time.

evaluations.evidence: detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Egg-laying event time detection is distinct from general motion analysis for shortening videos.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Disaster/feature detection in satellite imagery is not duplicated by other image-processing stories.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Weighting classifications by volunteer experience is distinct from interrupt/educate decisions and from volunteer-type identification.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artefact removal prefiltering is distinct from moving/transient object detection.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is distinct from artefact removal.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Noise removal is distinct from grouping whale calls and counting whales.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Clustering similar whale calls is distinct from counting whales in an audio file.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales is distinct from grouping calls by similarity.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Determining when to interrupt is distinct from determining interruption modality (text/image/video).

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Choosing interruption modality is a different goal from deciding whether/when to interrupt.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Determining when to educate is distinct from determining education modality and content selection.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Choosing education modality is distinct from deciding when to educate.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selecting specific educational content is distinct from deciding when to educate and which modality to use.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting volunteer comments is distinct from deciding when Zoonibot should comment or explain.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Bot-comment timing is distinct from bot-explanation timing and from deciding bot message content.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Bot-explanation timing is distinct from bot-comment timing and from deciding what the bot should say.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Message-content selection is distinct from deciding when the bot should comment/explain.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Subject similarity grouping is not duplicated elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation based on volunteer experience is distinct from content recommendations in the earlier (non-Zooniverse-admin) stories.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization for reuse is not expressed elsewhere.
